entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom@4.5.0
entries.content:
Profile headers and sticky tabs can now share measured geometry and material without application positioning overrides.

- Add `HeaderDockProvider`, `StickySection`, and `useHeaderDockInset` to the layout API. Web sections dock below the measured header; native lists retain sticky ownership and receive the appropriate offset for inline or overlapping headers.
- Add `PageHeader placement="overlap"` for banners behind a sticky header and `titleReveal="onDock"` for title/subtitle reveal as tabs arrive. Docked header and tabs share the inherited opaque surface fill.
- Add `Sidebar contentAlignment="center"` to center the main navigation group above its persistent footer, in panel and rail variants.

These APIs are additive. Existing placement and sidebar defaults remain unchanged. Native docking requires a list implementation supporting a sticky-header offset; Bloom does not reposition native list cells itself.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom@4.0.0
entries.content:
Bloom 4.0 brings the shared visual system to the current component catalog.

## Highlights
- Tonal application backgrounds and layered surfaces driven by Bloom theme presets, with paired foreground colors.
- Shared appearance, tone and size contracts, plus compatibility mappings for existing component APIs.
- Composable Screen, navigation and primary actions; refined sidebar, rail, header, bottom bar and FAB behavior.
- Consistent theming across chat, media, housing, stays, CRM, mail and notes components.
- Refined control gradients, toast transitions, segmented control dragging and responsive Storybook examples.
- New Workspace templates demonstrating the integrated system.

## Migration
This is a major visual and composition update. Review [the migration guide](https://github.com/OxyHQ/Bloom/blob/main/docs/coherent-system-migration.mdx) for preferred props, compatibility mappings, navigation and provider setup. Existing compatibility mappings do not imply that every previous export or visual default is unchanged.

## Validation
Build, TypeScript, consumer types and package/export verification passed. The 370 Jest suites were covered across shards and focused reruns. All 1,243 mobile stories were checked, with failures corrected and retested; 54 desktop templates passed. Physical iOS/Android validation was not performed.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom@3.1.0
entries.content:
The composition contracts from 3.0 now reach the rest of the catalogue, and where they do not, the matrix says so by name.

**Additive at the type level — `tsc` will not flag anything.** Two behaviour changes are worth reading first: [Migrating to 3.0 § 3.1](https://bloom.oxy.so/docs/migrating-to-3.0).

### Field membership went from one family to fifteen

`Checkbox`, `FileUpload`, `InputGroup`, `InputOtp`, `PhoneInput`, `Radio`/`RadioGroup`, `RatingInput`, `SegmentedControl`, `SelectTrigger`, `Slider`, `Stepper`, `Switch`, `Textarea`, `TextField` and `TimeField` read the enclosing `Field` through one function, `useFieldMembership()` — exported for your own controls too.

```tsx
<Field label="Notify members" error={errors.notify} disabled={locked}>
  <Switch value={notify} onValueChange={setNotify} />
</Field>
```

That switch announces "Notify members, switch, on", carries the field's id and `aria-describedby`, and is inert — `disabled={false}` on it cannot undo the field.

- **`Field disabled` now reaches fifteen more controls**, including the halves a composite owns: `PhoneInput`'s country picker and an `InputGroup` addon's `Button` used to stay operable inside a disabled field.
- **Six name props became optional** — `accessibilityLabel` on `Stepper`, `RatingInput` and `TimeField`, `label` on `RadioGroup`, `SegmentedControl` and `SelectTrigger` — because the field can supply the name. The dev-only warning reads the resolved name, so a field-named control no longer warns.
- **A label BESIDE a control still wins** (a checkbox's caption, a radio's option text), so the announced name matches what the eye reads. A label drawn *above* it yields to the field's.

### Density is inherited

`TextField`, `Textarea` and `TimeField` take `size` from the nearest `ControlSurface`, so a filter row asks once:

```tsx
<ControlSurface density="small">…</ControlSurface>
```

### A modal is its own screen

`ScreenScope` (from `@oxy.so/bloom/layout`) is a fresh top/bottom edge registry and a `null` scroll offset. `DialogBody` and `BottomSheetBase` mount it, so a header inside a dialog no longer claims the top edge of the page underneath it, and chrome inside a sheet no longer follows a scroller nobody is touching.

### New in the API

`useFieldMembership`, `useFieldControl` and the field types on the root barrel · `ScreenScope` · `disabled`, `nativeID` and `testID` on `SegmentedControl` · `nativeID` on `Switch`, `Checkbox` and `Radio` · `nativeID`/`aria-describedby`/`aria-invalid` on an anchored family's trigger handle.

### The measurement

[**Adoption matrix**](https://bloom.oxy.so/docs/adoption-matrix) — every family against every contract that applies to it, generated from the source and gated byte-identical. 161 families, 159 published, nothing unclassified. What is still open is named there: three families hand-write a grouped choice instead of composing `RadioGroup`/`Checkbox`, and seven reconcile a controlled pair by hand.

### Verified

`tsc` · consumer typecheck (1731 files) · `bob build` + `verify-package` (938 export targets) + build freshness · 328 of 332 suites, 7770 tests, 0 failures — the four shortfalls are the Node `vm` crash this repo records, reproduced on an unmodified `main`. iOS, Android and browser paint are **not** verified; nothing in this release changes paint.

Full detail: #149 · closes #148

entries.content:
Four additive feature PRs since 2.11.0. No breaking changes.

- **#130 `RatingInput`** — the star PICKER, so a review form stops being hand-rolled. `1..max`, fully controlled, no half-stars and no clearing; the group's `accessibilityLabel` is required because it draws nothing but stars.
- **#131 `listing-card`** — `hoverZoom` (web only, opt-in, behind `any-hover` and skipped under `prefers-reduced-motion`), `onLongPress` / `onContextMenu` carrying `MessageBubble`'s contract verbatim, and `WishlistCard` `icon` / `color` / `empty` so a collection can say what it is without an emoji inside its name.
- **#132 `stay-search`** — `DestinationSuggestion` `disabled` / `disabledReason`, so a row that cannot be chosen says why from INSIDE the `listbox` (arrow keys step over it, `aria-disabled`, never hover-highlighted); plus `GuestPicker` `decrementLabel` / `incrementLabel`, the last two English words in the picker.
- **#133 `TimeField`** — the hour and minute, typed, on `DateChipInput`'s geometry. Forgiving parse (`9`, `930`, `9.30`, `9pm`), `min`/`max`/`step` snapping, arrow keys; the value is always 24h `"HH:mm"".

Also in this release: `track-list/parts.tsx` drops the state `TrackIconButton` computed and never read after #117 made it a `GlyphButton` (#134), and the README's subpath count stays at 167 (#135).

**Verification** — sharded jest pass (321 suites, union checked by suite list), 7575 tests passed / 0 failed; 5 colour-and-theme suites crashed on the documented Node `vm`/contextify fault with zero failing assertions. `bun run typescript` clean. `verify:package` green: 15678 files packed, all 933 export targets present.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom@2.0.0 — Superbloom
entries.content:
# Bloom 2.0 — Superbloom

A superbloom is what happens when a desert flowers all at once. Bloom 2.0 is that release: a redesign of every existing component, 38 new families, a new icon set, a new UI typeface and a new license, landing together.

**Upgrading?** Read [`docs/migrating-to-2.0.mdx`](https://github.com/OxyHQ/Bloom/blob/main/docs/migrating-to-2.0.mdx). It ships inside the package.

## Highlights

- **38 new families.** App shells and navigation, data tables and twenty-one dashboard chart cards, AI and agent interfaces, a full form kit and a notification system — all on React Native, Expo and the web from one set of props.
- **A redesigned core.** Buttons, menus, selects, tabs, sliders, tooltips, toasts, avatars and more share one visual language, with colours still drawn from Bloom's theme and every recipe.
- **Remix Icon.** 336 Remix icons replace Bloom's hand-drawn set, with a codemod that migrates an app in one command.
- **Inter for the interface, JetBrains Mono for code.** BlomusModernus stays as Oxy's display face.
- **The Breathe License 1.0.**

## New families

- **Forms:** `phone-input`, `input-otp`, `textarea`, `date-picker`, `file-upload`, `button-group`, `social-button`, `auth-card`, `settings-modal`, `questionnaire`
- **Data and charts:** `table`, `data-table`, `chart-cards` (area, bar list, combo, earnings, funnel, heatmap, line, orders, radar, radial, revenue, sankey, scatter, tokens, agents, activity rings, contributions, most active days, sleep score, stage bars, steps), `stat-cards`, `recent-hires-card`, `patient-info-card`, `important-alerts-card`, `agent-limits-card`, `ai-profile-card`
- **App shell and navigation:** `app-shell`, `sidebar`, `breadcrumb`, `pagination`, `carousel`, `calendar`, `theme-toggle`
- **AI and agents:** `agent-chat`, `ai-chat`, `composer-panel`, `composer-loader`, `agent-thinking`, `agent-log`, `agent-progress`, `task-list`, `web-search`
- **Notifications:** `notification`, `notification-center`, `announcement`

New in existing families: `RangeSlider`, `CheckboxCard`, `RadioCard`, `CloseButton`, `CodeBlock`, the `TYPE_SCALE` type ramp, `Chip` hues, `Divider` variants, `Button` links and icon slots, `UserHoverCard` covers and loading state.

## Breaking changes

- **Removed:** `prompt-input` (use `ComposerPanel`), `combobox` (use `Select` or `Command`), `profile-card`, `benefit-list`, `level-picker`.
- **Icons:** every `*_Stroke2_Corner0_Rounded`-style export is gone. Run `node node_modules/@oxy.so/bloom/scripts/migrate-icons-to-remix.mjs <app> --dry-run --diff`. A stale icon name is not a type error, so run it even if your app compiles.
- **Fonts:** `fontFamilies.sans` is Inter (was BlomusModernus); `fontFamilies.mono` is JetBrains Mono (was Geist Mono).
- **Defaults:** `Slider` shows its value bubble and uses a 6px track; `SegmentedControl` defaults to `medium`; `Tabs` `outlined` renders as `pill`; `Avatar` initials use four deterministic tints; `Radio` dots are smaller and ignore `pressed`; `Divider` is 1px; the web `Select` list grows to 240px without scroll buttons; `Label` text is primary.
- **License:** Apache-2.0 → the Breathe License 1.0 (`LicenseRef-Breathe-1.0`). Vendored third-party material keeps its own license; see `NOTICE`.

The migration guide has every item above with the prop that restores the previous behaviour.

entries.title: @oxyhq/bloom@1.2.2
entries.content:
Fixes a flying video pausing the one you just landed on.

expo-video's web player mirrors pause across every element bound to it, the browser auto-pauses a `<video>` removed from the DOM, and `unmountVideoView` runs only in a passive effect cleanup — so the element on its way out paused the live one. Releasing a video surface now renders one commit with `player={null}` first, unbinding it while the node is still in the DOM. No defensive `play()`.

Image surfaces are unaffected and still release synchronously.

Also adds a browser gate phase asserting the clip is still playing mid-flight and after landing, and that `currentTime` advanced — geometry and first-frame gates pass a video frozen in the right place.

Scope: this closes the terminal pause, which is Bloom's. A freeze mid-flight caused by the consumer's own feed element leaving the DOM needs the same one-commit `player={null}` before navigating on that side.

entries.title: @oxyhq/bloom@1.2.1
@oxyhq/bloom@1.2.0
entries.content:
Media flight layer + the gallery becomes media-capable.

- `@oxyhq/bloom/media-flight` — a shared-element media surface that survives the route change, on web and native. `flyTo` resolves on the layer commit so the origin can be torn down without restarting a video; the layer hands off when the destination reports its first frame.
- `zoomable-image-gallery` -> `zoomable-media-gallery`: the viewer now pages video as well as images, fed by a `VideoPlayer` the consumer owns. `expo-video` is an optional peer.

BREAKING: two symbols renamed — `ZoomableImageGallery` -> `ZoomableMediaGallery`, `ZoomableImageGalleryHandle` -> `ZoomableMediaGalleryHandle`. The `@oxyhq/bloom/zoomable-image-gallery` subpath still resolves, and `GalleryImage` / `MeasuredRect` / `MeasureThumb` keep their names. Migration: docs/migrating-the-media-gallery.mdx

entries.title: Oxy ID v1.0 — self-sovereign civic identity + decentralization
entries.content:
# Oxy ID — self-sovereign civic identity + decentralization

This milestone turns **Commons by Oxy** into a citizen-identity app ("Oxy ID") with cryptographically-owned, verifiable reputation, and lays the foundation for user-run data nodes. The civic engine lives in `oxy-api`; ownership comes from **cryptography** (per-user hash-chained signed records) — Oxy is the fast read copy, the user owns the truth.

Full technical documentation: [`docs/`](./docs/) · chronological detail: [`docs/CHANGELOG.md`](./docs/CHANGELOG.md).

## Identity foundation (F0–F1)
- **`did:web:api.oxy.so:u:<id>`** account-anchored DIDs (custodial ↔ self-sovereign, reversible via `authMethods`).
- **Signed records v2** — a per-subject hash chain (`version/seq/prev/collection/rkey`, `RepoHead` O(1) head, shared `canonicalize`/`signedRecordSigningInput`). `verifyEnvelope` branches self-issued / Oxy-custodial / untrusted.
- **Oxy Trust reputation** — crypto-owned via Oxy-signed attestations; users never self-award.

## Anti-gaming + personhood + credentials (F2–F4)
- **Real-life QR attestation** (HIGH) + **random validator jury** (weighted-reservoir selection, graph/device/IP exclusion, slashing).
- **Proof-of-personhood** — web-of-trust vouches + staking + sybil clustering + random audits + on-device biometric (`evidence = 0.50·vouch + 0.35·real-life + 0.15·biometric`, θ=0.6 → verified tier).
- **Verifiable credentials** — issue / verify-against-current-issuer-VM / revoke.

## Decentralization — user nodes (F5)
- **`@oxyhq/node`** — self-hostable data-node server (signed-record log + blobs, reuses `@oxyhq/core` verification).
- **Oxy↔node**: public signed-log export; background **ingest** that re-verifies every record (signature + owner-DID + chain), **LWW** per `(collection,rkey)`, keeps forks, and **Oxy counter-signs** each ingested record (anti-rewrite witness).
- **Managed vault** — Oxy operates a node for non-technical users (custodial `controller:'oxy'`).
- **Invariant: reads NEVER touch a node** — a node down is stale, never slow.

## Product + SDK
- Clean rename **DNI → "Oxy ID"** everywhere; Commons nav restructured (merged ID landing, scan FAB, 3 tabs).
- App-wide clean UI pass (Apple/World App aesthetic) + redesigned Reputation screen.
- `@oxyhq/core` mixins: `identity`, `civic`, `reputation`, `nodes`. Full Commons UI for all of the above. **i18n en/es at 100% parity.**

## Notes
- npm packages are **not** published in this release (the SDK is consumed in-repo via `workspace:*`; civic/node contracts stay internal until the surface stabilizes).
- Deferred (infra): managed-vault container orchestration; seed personhood verifiers; karma→reputation migration; `REC_SCORING_V2`.
